notes: #84 compares original path components using EqualFold only for Windows paths; no transformed byte offset or traversal normalization. Native Windows and platform-specific filename collation not exercised.

#85 buffers bounded input before admission; all non-GET/HEAD workbench message requests except cancel/voice-release get a generation-bound cancellation lease. Lock/unlock transitions close admission, cancel all leases and await handler completion before persisting generation, without holding App.mu during network waits. Legacy Block wraps BlockContext for compatibility.

Already dispatched peer operations cannot be rolled back; background inbound messaging remains separate. No claim of a distributed transaction or instantaneous lock publication while an admitted non-cancellable local commit is finishing.
